thick_hide.name: Thick Hide
thick_hide.description: Tough, leathery skin provides natural protection against physical damage.

armored_shell.name: Armored Shell
armored_shell.description: A heavy carapace or shell offers tremendous protection at the cost of mobility.

soft_skinned.name: Soft Skinned
soft_skinned.description: Vulnerable flesh, but allows for greater agility and sensitivity.

razor_claws.name: Razor Claws
razor_claws.description: Sharp, retractable or fixed claws for rending prey and enemies.

deadly_fangs.name: Deadly Fangs
deadly_fangs.description: Powerful jaws lined with sharp teeth for biting attacks.

powerful_tail.name: Powerful Tail
powerful_tail.description: A muscular tail useful for balance, swimming, and combat.

opposable_thumbs.name: Opposable Thumbs
opposable_thumbs.description: Dexterous digits capable of fine manipulation. Essential for advanced tool use.

tentacles.name: Tentacles
tentacles.description: Flexible appendages for grasping and manipulation. Versatile but less precise than thumbs.

hooves.name: Hooves
hooves.description: Hard, keratinous feet for running and kicking. Poor manipulation.

natural_camouflage.name: Natural Camouflage
natural_camouflage.description: Skin patterns and coloration that blend with the environment. Enemies detect only when adjacent.

pheromone_trails.name: Pheromone Trails
pheromone_trails.description: Chemical signaling for communication with kin. Enhances coordination.

winged.name: Winged
winged.description: Wings capable of flight. Eliminates terrain traversal costs but reduces durability.

burrowers.name: Burrowers
burrowers.description: Adapted for digging through earth. Improves territory claiming and defensive capabilities.

aquatic.name: Aquatic
aquatic.description: Adapted for water. Excellent swimmers but struggle on land.

amphibious.name: Amphibious
amphibious.description: Comfortable both in water and on land, though master of neither.

venomous.name: Venomous
venomous.description: Produces toxins that can be delivered through bite or sting. Causes damage over time.

regeneration.name: Regeneration
regeneration.description: Slowly recovers from wounds over time. Can even regrow lost limbs.

echolocation.name: Echolocation
echolocation.description: Uses sound to detect surroundings. Effective in darkness and caves.

compound_eyes.name: Compound Eyes
compound_eyes.description: Multi-faceted eyes providing excellent peripheral vision and threat detection.

keen_senses.name: Keen Senses
keen_senses.description: Highly developed sight, smell, and hearing.

bioluminescence.name: Bioluminescence
bioluminescence.description: Produces natural light. Useful for signaling and navigation in darkness.

heat_resistant.name: Heat Resistant
heat_resistant.description: Thrives in hot environments. Resistant to fire and volcanic terrain.

cold_adapted.name: Cold Adapted
cold_adapted.description: Thick fur or blubber for cold climates. Thrives in tundra and mountains.

bloodthirsty.name: Bloodthirsty
bloodthirsty.description: An innate drive to hunt, fight, and kill. Actively seeks combat.

aggressive.name: Aggressive
aggressive.description: Quick to anger and willing to fight. Attacks when threatened.

pacifist.name: Pacifist
pacifist.description: Avoids violence whenever possible. Flees from conflict.

cautious.name: Cautious
cautious.description: Careful and risk-averse. Fights only when confident of victory.

reckless.name: Reckless
reckless.description: Acts without considering consequences. High risk, high reward.

hive_minded.name: Hive-Minded
hive_minded.description: Extreme collectivism. The individual is nothing; the whole is everything.

fiercely_independent.name: Fiercely Independent
fiercely_independent.description: Values autonomy above all. Resents authority and crowds.

pack_bonded.name: Pack Bonded
pack_bonded.description: Forms strong social bonds. Works well in groups.

tribal.name: Tribal
tribal.description: Strong in-group loyalty, suspicious of outsiders.

impulsive.name: Impulsive
impulsive.description: Acts quickly without deliberation. Fast but prone to mistakes.

methodical.name: Methodical
methodical.description: Thinks before acting. Slow but thorough and reliable.

stoic.name: Stoic
stoic.description: Endures hardship without complaint. Resistant to morale damage.

volatile.name: Volatile
volatile.description: Emotional and unpredictable. Can surge with power or collapse under pressure.

curious.name: Curious
curious.description: Driven to explore and understand. Quick learners.

incurious.name: Incurious
incurious.description: Content with the known. Resistant to new ideas.

devout.name: Devout
devout.description: Spiritually inclined. Generates faith easily and responds to divine guidance.

skeptical.name: Skeptical
skeptical.description: Questions everything, including the gods. Resistant to faith but prone to independent thought.

naturalistic.name: Naturalistic
naturalistic.description: Attuned to nature and living things. Understanding of ecosystems and biology.

calculative.name: Calculative
calculative.description: Mathematical and logical mind. Excels at engineering and planning.

intuitive.name: Intuitive
intuitive.description: Reads people and situations instinctively. Strong social intelligence.

analytical.name: Analytical
analytical.description: Breaks down problems systematically. Pure logical reasoning.

empathic.name: Empathic
empathic.description: Deeply feels and understands the emotions of others.

cunning.name: Cunning
cunning.description: Clever and scheming. Good at deception and manipulation.

wise.name: Wise
wise.description: Possesses deep understanding and good judgment. Elders are especially revered.

simple_minded.name: Simple-Minded
simple_minded.description: Limited cognitive complexity. Relies on instinct over reason.

hardy.name: Hardy
hardy.description: Tough constitution. Resistant to disease and starvation.

fertile.name: Fertile
fertile.description: High reproductive rate. Population grows quickly.

slow_breeding.name: Slow Breeding
slow_breeding.description: Few offspring, but each is precious and carefully raised.

migratory.name: Migratory
migratory.description: Instinct to move with the seasons. Fast but less attached to territory.

territorial.name: Territorial
territorial.description: Fiercely defends claimed land. Strong at home, reluctant to roam.

nomadic.name: Nomadic
nomadic.description: Lives on the move. No permanent settlements but highly mobile.

sedentary.name: Sedentary
sedentary.description: Prefers to stay in one place. Excellent settlers and builders.

opportunistic.name: Opportunistic
opportunistic.description: Adapts strategy based on circumstances. Jack of all trades.

specialized.name: Specialized
specialized.description: Highly adapted to specific conditions. Excels in niche but struggles elsewhere.

diminutive.name: Diminutive
diminutive.description: House cat sized. Tiny but numerous.

middling.name: Middling
middling.description: Ape sized. The baseline for most civilizations.

huge.name: Huge
huge.description: Bear sized. Powerful individuals, fewer in number.

behemoth.name: Behemoth
behemoth.description: Elephant sized. Legendary titans that shake the earth.

1.name: Mayfly
1.description: Lives fast, dies young. Brief candle in the wind.

2.name: Brief Candle
2.description: Short-lived but not ephemeral. Some may reach elderhood.

3.name: Mortal Span
3.description: A balanced lifespan. Time enough for mastery.

4.name: Long-Lived
4.description: Extended years. Elders are common and influential.

5.name: Ancient Ones
5.description: Near-immortal by mortal standards. A society of sages.

omnivore.name: Omnivore
omnivore.description: Eats both plants and meat. Balanced and adaptable.

predator.name: Predator
predator.description: Must hunt to survive. Swift and deadly, but dependent on prey.

herbivore.name: Herbivore
herbivore.description: Plant eaters. Peaceful grazers with natural harmony.

plains.name: Plains
plains.description: Open grasslands. Easy living, wide horizons.

forest.name: Forest
forest.description: Wooded lands. Shelter and resources aplenty.

jungle.name: Jungle
jungle.description: Dense tropical growth. Rich but dangerous.

mountains.name: Mountains
mountains.description: High peaks and valleys. Defensible but sparse.

desert.name: Desert
desert.description: Arid wastelands. Only the hardy survive.

tundra.name: Tundra
tundra.description: Frozen wastes. Endless cold and scarcity.

swamp.name: Swamp
swamp.description: Boggy wetlands. Disease and difficult terrain.

volcanic.name: Volcanic
volcanic.description: Land of fire and ash. Extremely dangerous.

coastal.name: Coastal
coastal.description: Where land meets sea. Trade and fishing.

underground.name: Underground
underground.description: Caverns and tunnels. Hidden and resource-rich.
